title: A clip dropped a frame from a cut lands on the cut
goal: Nine video walks fail the same way in both of the last two full walk runs: a clip dropped onto the timeline a frame short of a cut (5.96 s next to a cut at 6 s) now lands where it was dropped instead of on the cut, so it overlaps the clip before it, and every later trim, roll and transition is a frame off. Find out whether dropping stopped snapping to the cut or the walks' drop step changed, and make a drop beside a cut land on it, the way Premiere does with snapping on.
notes:

Failing in the 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-03 full runs. Possibly related: the-frame-shown-at-a-whole-second-is-the-one-tha (a 33 ms frame grid).
acceptance: Reproduce first: Scripts/playtest-all.sh --no-build a-cut-opens-into-its-two-clips-walk fails at step 30 with b-roll on V1 5.96s to 12.92s and Tutorial Sample 0.00s to 5.96s (seen 2026-11-03); say whether the drop at step 16 snapped before and what changed
At Next defaults with snapping on, a clip dropped within a few frames of a cut lands exactly on it and the clip before it keeps its full length; with snapping off it lands where it was dropped
If the app is right and the walks are wrong, the walks drop on the cut itself and the task log says why
